source: Onkelos on Exod 37:1-5; the byline law at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:1 with 10:3
claim_en: AND BEZALEL MADE THE ARK — the one vessel in the whole account carrying the craftsman's name; everything else was made at his word and counsel (Onkelos Exod 37; Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:1) — because the ark is where the Holy One COMPRESSES His Presence, and the name says it: Bezalel made the SHADE of God between the cherubim. And the attribution law rides: he GAVE HIS SOUL to the work, so his name is published on every stage — the byline goes to the soul-giver (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 10:3). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 37:2; the three chests at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:3 with 7:4; the rim's spelling at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 8:3
claim_en: Overlaid within and without, executed as THREE CHESTS — wood between two of gold, the lips sealed (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:3) — and decoded: a scholar's INSIDE MUST MATCH HIS OUTSIDE; the broken tablets also lie in the ark, so honor the broken and the poor in whom Torah sits (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:4). The crown-rim carries an ink-level written-and-read pair: written as the STRANGER-word, read as the CROWN-word — worthy, his crown; unworthy, a stranger to it — on the three vessel-crowns: ark the Torah's, altar the priesthood's, table the kingship's (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 8:3). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 8:1 with 8:2; the same-instrument doctrine at Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Vayakhel 9:1
claim_en: Revealed before Him-who-spoke that Israel would sin AT SHITTIM, He ordained SHITTIM-wood in the ark — the cure provisioned ahead of the disease (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 8:1); the Buber recension states the operator: He heals WITH THE WOUNDING INSTRUMENT — bitter wood sweetened Marah's bitter water, and the sin at Shittim is healed by shittim (Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Vayakhel 9:1). The plural command rides: for the ark alone THEY shall make — all Israel — so no man can claim the Torah is more his than his fellow's; Torah as water, free and unpriced, the desert its ownerless home, the convert equal to the high priest at it (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 8:2). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: The build-order dispute at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 6:5 with 6:3 and Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Vayakhel 8:3, against Babylonian Talmud Berakhot 55a; the as-run order at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 10:1; the eyewitness at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 10:2
claim_en: The dialogue verbatim: Bezalel asks what the tabernacle is FOR — 'that He may dwell in it and teach Torah'; 'and where will the Torah be placed?'; Moses orders house-then-ark; Bezalel answers ARK FIRST — the dependency argument, light before the palace (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 6:5, with the begin-with-light doctrine at 6:3; same track at Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Vayakhel 8:3) — while the Babylonian Talmud records the roles REVERSED: there Moses orders vessels-first and Bezalel argues house-first, 'the custom of the world' (Babylonian Talmud Berakhot 55a). A genuine two-recension dispute over which scheduling argument the exchange carried; the as-run order is its own record — boards, tent, veil, ark, cover, table, lampstand, 'the practice of kings' (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 10:1) — and R. Eleazar the son of R. Yose testifies: I SAW THE ARK COVER IN ROME, drops of the Atonement blood on it (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 10:2). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 37:6-9; the cave and the sea at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:2
claim_en: The cover and its cherubim HAMMERED from one piece, wings sheltering, faces one to the other inclined toward the cover — the meeting-point of EX25-05 built (Onkelos Exod 37). The spine supplies the metaphysics at this furniture: a cave at the sea's edge — the sea rushes in, the cave FILLS, the sea is not diminished; so the glory will FILL the tabernacle while remaining above heaven and earth, and the Presence compresses even into the ark itself (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:2). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 37:5; the carrying protocol at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:13 with 7:14
claim_en: The poles in the rings TO CARRY the ark (Onkelos Exod 37) — and the spine's transport spec: the Kohathites bear it, the veil borne before it by two senior priests on poles — a handbreadth thick, seventy-two strands of twenty-four threads, three hundred priests to handle it — then the sealskin cover ON, so that none SEE the holy as it is covered, lest they die; the glance of an eye-blink kills (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:13; the blink-reading at 7:14). Numeric claims opened in full, the two recensions' tables cross-checked. Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.
